items.question: What is virtual try-on for Shopify?
items.answer: Virtual try-on lets shoppers see a product on themselves. They upload or take a photo on your product page and Brix-Tryon shows them wearing it, so they can decide with more confidence.

items.question: How does Brix-Tryon work?
items.answer: Shoppers click Try On This Look on your product page, accept the privacy notice and upload or take a photo. Brix-Tryon generates a photo of them wearing the product. They enter an email and phone number to unlock the full-size result, then add to cart, buy now, save the image or share it on WhatsApp.

items.question: How does virtual try-on help conversion?
items.answer: Shoppers who can see a garment on themselves have less to guess about fit and look, so they feel more sure about adding it to the cart. Brix-Tryon also captures an email and phone number for follow-up, and the Analytics page shows try-ons, cart rate and purchase rate so you can measure the effect on your own store.

items.question: Do shoppers need an account or an app?
items.answer: No. Shoppers click Try On This Look on your product page, accept the privacy notice and upload or take a photo. There is nothing to install and no account to create.

items.question: Is the shopper's photo stored?
items.answer: A consent notice appears before upload, and the photo is not stored after processing.

items.question: What does the free plan include?
items.answer: 10 monthly AI try-ons, a responsive widget for mobile and desktop, a privacy consent screen, try-on on the product page, standard AI processing and email support.

items.question: How much does Brix-Tryon cost?
items.answer: Free is $0 with 10 try-ons a month. Growth is $19 a month with 100 try-ons, and Pro is $49 a month with 500 try-ons.

items.question: What happens if I go over my try-on limit?
items.answer: Extra try-ons are billed per use at the rate shown on your plan: $0.28 on Free, $0.15 on Growth and $0.08 on Pro. Try-on keeps working for your shoppers.

items.question: Which products does Brix-Tryon support?
items.answer: Brix-Tryon is built for fashion and apparel: dresses, tops, jackets, suits and more. You can enable try-on by collection or by product.

items.question: Does virtual try-on reduce returns?
items.answer: It can help, because shoppers have less to guess about how a piece looks on them. Your Analytics page shows try-ons, cart rate and purchase rate, so you can see the effect on your own store.

items.question: Can I customise how the try-on button looks?
items.answer: Yes. In Widget Settings you can set button text, colours, radius, size, padding and fonts separately for desktop and mobile, with a live preview.
